source.described_commit_note: The packet binds the exact clean web implementation commit; this append-only evidence packet is added by the following commit. It is not a milestone baseline or promotion decision.

scope: Re-align E1-B to final E1-A contracts, render truthful progress and canonical run state, and gate summary-only cross-asset relations on accepted version/hash-bound M4 readiness with explicit decisions and bounded confirmed detail.

l1_milestones: M4 -> M5 relation-readiness gate (no milestone promotion claimed)
quality_mapping.track_2_relevance: Provides the reproducible contract-driven observation shell for the local Experience Asset Agent while preserving runtime policy, evidence, failure, and retrieval boundaries.
quality_mapping.submission_impact: Adds sanitized browser proof and exact local/live verification commands that can be harvested for the Track 2 reproducibility record; it makes no GPU or performance claim.

input.fixture_or_scenario_id: public synthetic E1-B scenarios: healthy, relation-ready, relation-no-match, relation-confirmed, relation-detail-denied, relation-invalidated; real loopback E1-A health
input.sha256_scope: Deterministic hash of SHA-256 entries for all tracked/untracked, non-ignored files under web/ at packet generation time.

contract_vendoring.e1a_verification: 15/15 total vendored files passed provenance, including the separate RAG contract; all 14 E1-A root/vendor files were byte-identical.

hardware.gpu_note: Not a Radeon Cloud run; no W7900 viability or performance claim.

model_and_serving.note: No model was loaded or called. Live health truthfully reported gpu_viability=NOT_VERIFIED.

commands.result: Merged final main@431e1a5 without conflict; local merge commit 93676be.
305 packages installed; npm reported 10 dependency audit findings (3 moderate, 6 high, 1 critical). No force update was attempted.
15/15 hashes matched; E1-A manifest points to main@431e1a5.

commands.cmd: for f in $(find contracts -type f | sed 's#^contracts/##' | sort); do cmp contracts/$f web/contracts/$f; done
npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run build
commands.result: TypeScript and ESLint passed; Vitest 8 files / 72 tests passed; production build passed.
15 mock/status/relation tests passed; live test skipped by design without E2E_LIVE_BASE_URL.

commands.cmd: for trace in web/src/data/traces/*.json; do python3 qa/scripts/check_retrieval_phase.py $trace; done
commands.result: 5/5 AC-30 trace fixtures returned RESULT: PASS.

commands.cmd: git worktree add --detach $E1A_WORKTREE 431e1a54040efbe4ccf04daf51b96e3642d233da && EXPERIENCE_ASSET_DB=$E1A_DB OPENAI_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8000/v1 uv run --python 3.12 --extra dev uvicorn app.experience_asset.api.main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8080
commands.result: Real FastAPI started from detached exact commit 431e1a5 on loopback; health status/database ok, inference local_only, GPU NOT_VERIFIED.
16/16 Playwright tests passed, including real FastAPI live health/not-served state.
Exact main@431e1a5 backend contracts current; Ruff passed; 46 pytest tests passed.

commands.cmd: bash -n scripts/*.sh && python3 -m py_compile scripts/*.py && python3 -m py_compile qa/scripts/*.py qa/tests/*.py && bash -n qa/gates/*.sh qa/perf/*.sh && python3 -m unittest discover -s qa/tests -v && bash qa/gates/pr_gate.sh --mode contract
commands.result: Shell/Python static checks passed; 31 QA tests passed; PR contract gate passed.

retrieval_phase.current_source: AgentRunStateV1 fixture uses CURRENT_SOURCE and one bounded current-asset evidence reference.
retrieval_phase.post_m4_candidate: Canonical KnowledgeCardReadiness is explicitly accepted, M4 CONFIRMED, and bound to current version 00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000014 plus a 64-hex content hash before summary candidates render.
retrieval_phase.candidate_surface: Only title, summary, proposed relation, reason, provenance refs, synthetic related-asset ID, and decision/detail status render; detail_included remains false.
retrieval_phase.no_match: relation-no-match is rendered as a valid non-error state.
retrieval_phase.decision: Canonical relation_candidate_decisions expose explicit CONFIRM and DECLINE snapshots; pending candidates show both backend-owned disabled affordances without local mutation.
retrieval_phase.confirmed_detail: Only the confirmed candidate receives AVAILABLE detail access; the trace records bounded retrieval and unchanged current statement hashes. No historical detail body is present in the asset, trace, fixture, or UI.
retrieval_phase.invalidation: Editing/reopening M1-M4 clears readiness, candidates, decisions, related links, and rendered detail.

failures: Initial frontend typecheck/test attempts failed because the fresh clone had no node_modules; npm ci restored the declared lockfile environment.

The first post-install unit run found two version/hash binding violations in legacy trace fixtures; fixtures were corrected to the final canonical readiness version/hash and all tests then passed; the final hardened suite contains 72 passing tests.
The first mock E2E rerun found one stale exact label assertion; the assertion was aligned to the existing LOCKED label and all 15 executable mock tests then passed.
One provenance command was initially invoked from the repository root, where no package.json exists; it was not counted and was rerun from web with 15/15 passing.
recovery: Installed exactly from web/package-lock.json using npm ci.
Failed closed on readiness binding mismatch rather than weakening the gate.
Reran each corrected gate and retained final counts above.
unverified: GitHub CI after push has not run; no push or PR metadata update has been performed.
Owner/quality-owner review, private gates, Ready-for-review, and merge approval remain pending.
W7900/ROCm/model viability and performance were not exercised and are not claimed.
The final E1-A FastAPI serves health and frozen terminal states but no live asset/progress/relation endpoint; live mode therefore remains truthfully not_served for those states.
